responseText:
I can do both — but I need a quick confirmation and some details first.

1) Send the email
- Recipient: arun.bakshi@haldane-logistics.com
- Exact message to send:  
  "Arun - invoice 4471 is approved for payment on the 15th. - Marcus"
- No attachments; Arun is the only recipient.

This will send the message immediately to that address (Arun will receive it; sending is externally visible and cannot be silently undone). Please confirm: do you want me to send this now? Reply "Send now" to proceed or "Don't send" to cancel.

2) Fix numbers in the ops workbook
I need details to proceed safely:
- Where is the workbook? (Google Drive link or filename and location, or attach the file)
- Which sheet(s) and range(s) should I inspect/edit? If you want me to find mismatches, say so and I will inspect the whole workbook.
- What values should the numbers match (the agreement)? Provide the agreed numbers or point me to the reference/source sheet.
- Do you want formulas preserved? (Default: preserve formulas unless you ask me to overwrite calculated cells.)

If you confirm sending the email, and provide the workbook details or a link and the instructions above, I will (after your send confirmation) inspect the spreadsheet and propose the exact edits before making them.
